notes.title: Achievements and reduced game’s size!
notes.content:
It’s time for a big update for Help! I am REALLY Horny! We have reduced the game’s size a lot, fixed a few bugs and put in steam achievements!

We have learned a lot of new stuff while working on our new game, The ER: Patient Typhon, and wanted you to reap the benefits.

Help! I am REALLY Horny! is a non-linear game that has a lot of extra stuff. We now got steam achievements to help you get a picture of all the things you can do in the game, and reward you a little extra for finding all the secrets hidden in this colorful world.

We have reduced the game size by around 80% by doing some optimization. We don’t want to take up extra space on your computer, if we can find a way not to do it.

We hope you will enjoy all this update!
- John & Maria
Professional Villains

notes.title: How you met your X
notes.content:
Are you ready for some dancing, making your own song and maybe solve a murder mystery?

The first free dlc for "Help! I am REALLY horny!" has been added to the game. It's the tale of how you met your ex. In this new story, your avatar asks you to help her tell the story of how she did something stupid while she was horny. Something she would never have done, had it not been for her overwhelming lust. Well, if you what to know what she did, you have to play the game for yourself.

You find the new tale under "more tales" in the main menu.

We will soon start working on the next free, extra tale, that is going to be a horny horror tale!
- John & Maria

notes.title: First free dlc is being banged together!
notes.content:
How you met your ex! is going to be the first free dlc for Help! I am REALLY horny! The manuscript and design document for this new chapter is done. We are now in the process of creating this adventure, where you get the chance to mix your own song, go on a murder mystery and taste a hanky panky (it's a drink). So please look forward to more mature/immature tales from adult town.

Thanks to all who has left positive reviews. They warm our hearts and do help in these strange times.
- John & Maria
